node.statement: Functional calculus commutes with this amplification: applying lem-compcb-amplification-naturality to T_{P,Q} gives theta(I_n tensor T_{P,Q})=I_n tensor theta(T_{P,Q}) whenever the stated convergence condition holds; using def-compressed-corner, theta(T_{P,Q})=Co_{P,Q} and theta(T_{P_n,Q_n})=Co_{P_n,Q_n}.
